subject: Tollgate blocker: engineering backlog — request for trial credit supplement
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@wyrmtech.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, samuel.lewis@wyrmtech.com
Cc: 
Date: 2028-04-22T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Integration tollgate — blocked on prod adapter, need trial help

Hi Stephanie (and Sam),

Quick note from our side — we hit a hard stop in the production adapter validation yesterday. Our infra team is overloaded this sprint and the engineers who own the adapter are pulled into a critical outage elsewhere. The result: our Redwood evaluation is stuck on a test that requires secure session token replay, and we can't move to the demo stage.

This is blocking our execs — they want to see the full integration in a sandbox before we sign the SOW. Can Redwood provide a short-term credit supplement and extend the trial window by two weeks while we clear this engineering backlog? If we get the runway we can complete the demo and finalize requirements by May 8.

Attached: error_log.txt, screenshot.png — the failing handshake and a sample stacktrace.

High level timeline we can commit to if we get runway:
- Apr 24: hand off additional logs and a failing test case
- Apr 26-30: our infra team does a focused fix
- May 2: demo with engineering and product stakeholders

Appreciate any help you can offer — we want to keep momentum.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Director of Integrations, WyrmTech
elena.rossi@wyrmtech.com
+1 415 555 0127

Elena — thanks for the crisp summary and logs. Sorry to hear the timing landed on a sprint bottleneck.

Ben (AE) and Marissa (CS) — looping you in so we can coordinate an operational response. Quick asks from our side to expedite review:
- Can you confirm the exact demo date you need pinned (you mentioned May 2) and whether May 8 is the absolute cutoff for SOW approval?
- Is the failing test reproducible in a staging environment or only in customer infra?

Proposed immediate next steps (internal + external):
1) We can provision an additional 10k token credit as a provisional supplement to keep the evaluation running while your team fixes the adapter.
2) We can extend the trial by 14 days, subject to a short follow-up around May 9 to validate progress.

Ben/Marissa — recommend we treat this as a conditional, manager-approved promo that requires a short write-up (one pager) and an engineering confirmation once the fix is in staging. Markus, can you advise if we need a formal approval for credits of this size or if AE sign-off + CS confirmation is sufficient?

Elena — if that provisional plan works, I'll draft the confirmation and send the conditional terms (small PDF) for your records.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Folks — reviewing the logs Elena sent. This looks like a straightforward session token replay edge case; low risk on our side to extend a small credit and keep momentum. My suggested conditional offer:

- 10,000 token credit (apply immediately to the WyrmTech trial account)
- Trial extension +14 days (new expiry: 2028-05-16)
- Condition: WyrmTech provides confirmation of staging reproduction and a recorded demo by May 6. If demo happens and integration moves to acceptance, we will convert the credit to an onboarding discount at contract signature.

I can apply the credit as soon as we have manager verbal sign-off. Markus — do we need to route this through finance for a promo code or can you approve directly? I attached a short draft of the conditional terms (conditional_credit_terms.pdf) to speed review.

Elena / Sam — good news: we've provisionally approved the request. Summary below and next steps so everyone has the same expectations.

What we're approving now:
- 10,000 token trial credit applied to your evaluation account (visible in the console immediately).
- Trial expiry extended to 2028-05-16 (14 extra days).
- Conditional: Redwood requires confirmation of a staging reproduction and a recorded demo by 2028-05-06. If those conditions are met we will apply the credit toward onboarding incentives at contract signature; if not, the credit remains a one-time courtesy.

Action items / timeline:
- WyrmTech: replicate the failing test in staging and share reproduction steps by Apr 26 (Sam).
- WyrmTech: record the demo and share the link by May 6 (Elena).
- Redwood (Ben/Marissa): monitor the account activity and be ready to escalate to finance if conversion happens.

I've attached the conditional terms PDF for your records (conditional_credit_terms.pdf). Ben — please create the promo code and confirm when the credit posts (I applied a soft hold to avoid accidental pre-spend).

Elena — I know this is tight given your engineering load; if anything slips, tell us immediately so we can be pragmatic about the follow-ups. We want to see you across the finish line.
